## Overview

**Roderick** is one of the **Four Blood Brothers** — the knights who rose from the crowd at Aegon's trial to stand beside him in the **Judgment of Five**. He fought with Aegon, survived the brutal melee, and now serves as a commander in the new **Order of the Protectors**.

The quietest of the four. He speaks little but watches everything. His intelligence keeps the Protectors one step ahead of the Scales' hunters.

---

## Current Status

Separated from Aegon — coordinating the spy network within the Order of the Scales. If any of the five infiltrators are compromised, Roderick will be the first to know — and the first to act.
